name: Evolution PowerX Corp.
summary: Evolution PowerX Corp., through its subsidiaries, operates as an equipment rental services company in Canada. The company provides critical site infrastructure and services. It also offers wellsite trailer delivery, thermal pipeline expansion, wellsite equipment, field operations and equipment, equipment delivery, thermal pipe expansion, and well-site trailers. Additionally, the company provides natural gas power technologies and infrastructure construction services. It serves energy and resource sectors. The company was formerly known as Enterprise Group, Inc. and changed its name to Evolution PowerX Corp. in July 2026. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in St. Albert, Canada.
